messages:
samir: Tiny emergency: someone turned the thermostat to Arctic and the office is now a tundra. who did this? :cold_face:

ivy: that was me. i was wearing a sweater and thought the room was a little muggy. i swear it felt like heroism. :sweat_smile:

ben: Arctic? it's a crime scene. my plants are filing grievances.

janet: plants have rights. also, please do not try to smuggle a sweater into meetings as an accessory to your crime.

office-bot: Reminder: Thermostat changes are logged. Please use the climate-control request form for large adjustments. Automated notice.

samir: logging noted. but i propose we settle this with the ancient Redwood ritual: the Thermostat Treaty.

ivy: details? i want to avoid exile to the breakroom.

ben: Treaty terms: 1) No temp change > 2 degrees without consensus 2) Perpetrator provides warm beverage for affected coworkers 3) Offender wears "Climate Mediator" sticker for 24h.

janet: also add clause: if plants suffer, offender must perform a watering ceremony.

ivy: i accept terms. i'll make hot chocolate and bring marshmallows. peace offering. :chocolate_bar:

samir: vote: react with :thumbsup: to approve Treaty.

office-bot: Thermostat log entry: user ivy changed temp at 09:12. Please file disputes with facilities within 48 hours.

ben: tally: 3 thumbs up. Treaty ratified. thanks for the cocoa, ivy.

ivy: bringing cocoa in 15. also, can we get a sticky note above the thermostat that says "Ask before you freeze us"?

janet: brilliant. i'll design a tiny laminated sign.

samir: closing the case of the Great Arctic Incident. long live the Treaty. :scroll:
__notes: Single Slack thread string, chronological messages, prefixed with sender names as required by agents.md. No title field included.
